description: This Java source file defines the ProgramWorkflow class, a core component of the OpenMRS healthcare system. It manages workflows within medical programs, including states, transitions, and associated concepts. The class provides methods for adding/removing states, retrieving states by ID or name, checking legal state transitions, and sorting states. It serves as a fundamental part of the patient program management module.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflow
classes.description: Represents the workflow of a medical program, managing its states, concept, and related transitions in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: addState
methods.description: Adds a new ProgramWorkflowState to this ProgramWorkflow, setting the state’s parent workflow.

methods.name: removeState
methods.description: Removes a ProgramWorkflowState from this ProgramWorkflow, clearing its parent reference.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState matching the given concept.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState matching the given concept name in any locale.

methods.name: getStateByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState matching the given name in any locale.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Returns all non-retired ProgramWorkflowStates; includes retired ones based on parameter.

methods.name: getSortedStates
methods.description: Returns all ProgramWorkflowStates sorted by concept name, using natural order.

methods.name: getPossibleNextStates
methods.description: Returns potential next states for a given PatientProgram.

methods.name: isLegalTransition
methods.description: Checks if transition from one state to another is valid within this workflow.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this ProgramWorkflow.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflowId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this ProgramWorkflow.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the system-wide unique ID of this object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the system-wide unique ID for this object.

methods.name: getNonRetiredStateCount
methods.description: Returns the count of states that are not retired.
